decisive_source_package: Antamina delivered ounces, cash receipts, tax/interest allocation, debt-service waterfall, lender allocation, reserve-life and IRR/NPV support
source_route_or_local_base: Wheaton quarterly/annual filings, PMPA notes, 6-K exhibits, credit facility documents, Antamina reserve/mine-life disclosures
fields_to_extract: delivered ounces; ounces sold; cash receipts; cash cost; depletion; Antamina-specific tax; Antamina-specific interest; debt service; lender allocation; reserves; mine life; IRR; NPV
pass_test: Pass if Antamina source/use, production deliveries, cash receipts, cost, tax/interest or explicit non-allocation, debt-service support, reserve life, and return model can be joined without unsupported allocation.
hold_or_disproof_test: Hold if evidence remains revenue/OCF/profit proxy only; disprove full-return claim if cash receipts or reserve-life economics cannot be separated.
safe_claim: Wheaton is the first proof hunt because it is closest to named asset cash-return proof.

decisive_source_package: 2027 SPPCRC actual/estimated filing, billing determinants, category allocation workpapers, customer receipts, and financing support
source_route_or_local_base: Florida PSC Docket 20250010-EI, FPL SPPCRC filings/workpapers/discovery, SEC utility financing disclosures
fields_to_extract: actual billed revenue; collected/refunded true-up; rate class; billing determinant; category allocation; Distribution Inspection revenue requirement; debt/equity/cash funding source; construction funding language
pass_test: Pass if Distribution Inspection can be tied to billed/collected customer revenue or a defensible allocation from approved factors, plus source-of-funds support.
hold_or_disproof_test: Hold if only aggregate SPPCRC recovery is visible; disprove category-cash claim if category allocation is unavailable or contradictory.
safe_claim: FPL is the strongest regulated recovery bridge but the decisive customer-receipt source is partly time-gated.

decisive_source_package: Train/entity project waterfall, SPA economics, cargo mapping, capex, restricted cash, debt draw, EBITDA and debt-service support
source_route_or_local_base: Cheniere SEC filings, SPL/CQP/CCH indentures, offering memoranda, FERC dockets, DOE cargo records, customer filings and SPA summaries
fields_to_extract: train; entity; capex; debt draw; restricted cash; SPA volume; price formula; customer; cargo; revenue; EBITDA; distributions; debt service; waterfall
pass_test: Pass if one train or entity joins funding source, project cost, customer/cargo output, revenue/cash, distributions, and debt-service coverage.
hold_or_disproof_test: Hold if evidence remains company-level revenue, DCF, cargo count, or entity debt only; disprove train-return claim if cash cannot be attributed.
safe_claim: Cheniere is the best energy infrastructure candidate for a true project waterfall test.

decisive_source_package: Fleet-class OEC, utilization, growth/replacement capex, rental cash, sale proceeds, segment profit, borrowing-base certificates and collateral reports
source_route_or_local_base: URI 10-Q/10-K, earnings supplements, ABL/AR securitization documents, fleet category disclosures, used-equipment sales tables
fields_to_extract: fleet class; beginning OEC; ending OEC; utilization; rental revenue; gross margin; growth capex; replacement capex; sale proceeds; eligible collateral; reserves; advance rate; segment operating profit; ROIC
pass_test: Pass if fleet-class capital invested can be tied to utilization/output, rental cash/margin, sale recovery, collateral availability and ROIC-like denominator.
hold_or_disproof_test: Hold if only company-level OEC, OCF, revenue or segment margin is available; disprove fleet-class cash-yield claim if class-level denominator is absent.
safe_claim: URI is a high-quality cash-yield proxy that needs fleet-class granularity before ROIC claims.

decisive_source_package: Owner funding, retainage/receivable aging, bonded backlog, actual L/C/surety usage, project margin and collection schedules
source_route_or_local_base: Sterling 10-Q/10-K, July 2026 credit agreement, project awards, owner budget records, receivable/retainage notes, surety and L/C disclosures
fields_to_extract: project; owner; funded award; RPO; signed backlog; unsigned awards; backlog burn; billed receivables; retainage; contract assets; contract liabilities; L/C outstanding; surety; margin; cash collection
pass_test: Pass if backlog conversion can be tied to funded owner support, billing/retainage/collection, risk wrapper and project margin.
hold_or_disproof_test: Hold if only aggregate RPO and company OCF are visible; disprove cash-collection claim if backlog is mostly unsigned, cancellable, or uncollected.
safe_claim: Sterling is close to project cash proof but needs owner and collection evidence.

decisive_source_package: Named-project capital schedules, shipper/customer contracts, tariff billing volumes, utilization, project EBITDA, DCF contribution and debt-service allocation
source_route_or_local_base: Energy Transfer 10-Q/10-K, project disclosures, pipeline tariff records, FERC/state filings, shipper agreements where public, credit agreement draw/use records
fields_to_extract: project; capex; debt/cash source; shipper; committed volume; tariff/rate; billing volume; utilization; in-service date; revenue; EBITDA; DCF contribution; debt service
pass_test: Pass if one named project links funding, capex, customer/shipper economics, utilization, cash contribution and debt-service.
hold_or_disproof_test: Hold if evidence remains company-level EBITDA, DCF, capex or refinancing only.
safe_claim: Energy Transfer needs project-level records before company cash proxy can become project cash proof.

decisive_source_package: Athene statutory filings, Schedule D/BA, investment income, realized gains/losses, impairments, NAIC designations, liability cost and borrower-level holdings
source_route_or_local_base: State insurance statutory annual statements, NAIC schedules, Apollo/Athene supplements, rating-agency reports, investment income notes

pass_test: Pass if liability-funded assets can be tied to statutory holdings, income/spread, credit quality and cash/realization evidence in the same period.
hold_or_disproof_test: Hold if evidence remains AUM, inflows, invested assets or spread proxy; disprove statutory-cash claim if legal-entity schedules cannot support it.

decisive_source_package: Global Atlantic statutory schedules, Schedule D/BA, NAIC designations, borrower/facility schedules, FHLB collateral files and liability-cost spread schedules
source_route_or_local_base: State statutory filings, KKR/Global Atlantic supplements, BDC/N-PORT schedules, borrower credit agreements and rating reports

pass_test: Pass if Global Atlantic liability/asset sources can be mapped to statutory holdings, income/cash and borrower/facility allocation without overclaiming.
hold_or_disproof_test: Hold if only consolidated insurance investment categories are visible; disprove borrower allocation if schedules do not identify borrower/facility routes.

decisive_source_package: Frontline Road Safety borrower credit agreement, lender schedule, use-of-proceeds, payoff/bank-role evidence, borrower financials and repayment support

hold_or_disproof_test: Hold if evidence remains BDC fair value/commitment only; disprove bank-displacement claim if banks retain material facility roles.

decisive_source_package: BXSL/BCRED schedules, N-PORT, insurance SMA holdings, borrower credit agreements, lender allocations, payoff letters, borrower financials and repayment evidence

decisive_source_package: Borrowing notices, lender schedules, reserve report, BLM closing statement, acquisition funds-flow, asset-area production and cash-margin support

decisive_source_package: Redemption settlement, pro forma interest, fee amortization, tax effects, ABL availability, borrowing-base certificate, outage normalization and refinery-level cash contribution
